name: Cult-Tastic: Tales from the Trenches with Roger and Julie Corman
summary: Roger and Julie Corman detail their lifetime of innovative genre filmmaking. The Cormans' discuss their iconic pool of collaborators and their bare-bones production philosophy that created some of film's most memorable SFX sequences.

name: Geek Girl
summary: Harriet Manners' life is turned upside down when she's thrust into the world of fashion. Tightly wound agents, off-beat designers, impossibly high heels, a cute supermodel with a great smile, Harriet has no idea what she's in for.

name: The Lucie Arnaz Show
summary: Dr. Jane Lucas is a psychologist who dispenses advice on a radio call-in show, while also juggling a private practice and a freelance writing gig.

name: Brennpunkt: Ære
summary: Young Norwegian girls live in fear that their parents will find them and kill them. Brennpunkt reveals how powerless we in Norway are when it comes to the culture of honor.

name: Brennpunkt Nord-Irland
summary: Visit war-torn Northern Ireland.

name: Quest Means Business
summary: Richard Quest and a team of correspondents analyze the facts and figures from the business world to help people earn money and spend it wisely.

name: WondLa
summary: WondLa centers around Eva, a curious, enthusiastic and spirited teenager being raised in a state-of-the-art underground bunker by Muthr, a robot caretaker. On her 16th birthday, an attack on Eva's bunker forces her onto the Earth's surface, which is now inhabited by aliens and covered with otherworldly fauna, and there are no other humans to be found. In fact, it's no longer called Earth, but Orbona. Otto, a lovable giant waterbear with whom Eva shares telepathic powers and Rovender, a cantankerous alien with a troubled past, join Eva as she leads the team on a dangerous quest to find humans, her home and her true destiny.

name: Olympic Highlights with Kevin Hart and Kenan Thompson
summary: Olympic Highlights with Kevin Hart and Kenan Thompson will bring their signature hilarious insights to recap the 2024 Olympics' best and most unexpected moments throughout the Games.

name: Pillowcase Murders
summary: When dozens of women die unexpectedly at Senior Living Communities, no one suspects that a diabolical sociopath has turned mass murder into his day job.

name: Destination Heaven
summary: A faith quandary when God encounters people who believe they're doing the right things, but discover their approach lacks of emotional or intellectual growth.

name: This is Going to Be Big
summary: A heart-warming documentary following a group of neurodivergent teenagers as they prepare for their first high school musical, confronting their challenges and dreams.

name: Drugs, Inc.: The Fix
summary: Those enhanced episodes unwraps the facts behind the illegal drug trade.

name: World's Greatest Natural Icons
summary: From the top of Mount Everest to a fiery Russian volcano, from a sand blasted Middle Eastern desert to the Norway's Fjordlands, the planet consists of extraordinary natural wonders each hosting unique ecology and culture. World's Greatest Natural Icons reveals how the forces of earth, fire, ice, water and wind birthed these iconic formations and how those icons influence life and humanity.

name: Dibo the Gift Dragon
summary: Dibo is big, really big .... but he is the ultimate benefactor. He is the big brother that all kids dream about. When he greats friends, he squeezes himself to be smaller so that he can look eye-to-eye with the smaller ones. When he laughs, sometimes, he falls over backwards because he laughts so hard.

name: Hikaru Kimi E
summary: Depicting the life of the author of "The Tale of Genji", Murasaki Shikibu, during the Heian era. She uses her feelings for Fujiwara no Michinaga, her hidden passion and her unique imagination to craft her story while living her life with an unwavering heart in a changing world.

name: Inside NASA's Innovations
summary: Inside NASA's Innovations takes you behind the scenes with one of the world's leading technology innovators. Discover how you can collaborate with NASA in developing the next breakthrough in space exploration.

name: Build Your Own Home
summary: Build Your Own Home follows the trials and tribulations of homeowners from across Ireland. The series will chart the mammoth challenges faced by the participants as they set out to build their own home under the watchful eye of master builder and building teacher, Harrison Gardner. Over days, weeks and months of hard labour, the homeowners are taught and mentored by Harrison, an Australian eco-builder and sustainability designer, who believes that anyone can learn how to build.

name: Connect the World
summary: Live from Abu Dhabi with Becky Anderson, this is CNN International's flagship Middle East two hour news program.

name: Абонент временно недоступен...
summary:
Lana has everything every woman dreams of: a family, a child, a business. But her husband's betrayal turns her whole life upside down...
Deep depression and, as a consequence, amnesia, lead a young woman to an unfamiliar family, in which she is mistaken for another... Meanwhile, her husband deprives her of everything she had.
Will someone else's life become her own for Lana or will she "resurrect from the dead"? Will she forgive her husband's betrayal or is she destined for a new love?...

name: Who Killed WCW?
summary: Who Killed WCW? will explore the complex factors that led to the promotion's downfall, including management challenges, creative decisions, and the intense competition during the infamous Monday Night Wars. It will feature exclusive, in-depth interviews with wrestlers, executives, and insiders and will shed light never seen before on the personal stories and struggles of those who lived through the rise and fall of WCW.

name: Helluva Shorts
summary: NEXT EPISODE COMING VERY SOON DON'T WORRY!! But we are excited to introduce- we are doing some new Helluva SHORTS! We want to bring everyone more Helluva content between episodes and there's just too many fun adventures to have with these characters- so enjoy the first of many Helluva shorts!!

name: Faboriginal
summary: Comedian Steven Oliver is joined by two celebrity teams to answer tricky art questions, in this hilarious and deadly new art game show.

name: Monty Python's Best Bits (Mostly)
summary: This series is presented by self-confessed Python nut Hugh Bonneville, each show with a group of five famous comedians remembering their favourite Python moments. Each guest chooses a sketch (or two) and it's played with their comments.

name: The Killing of Father Niall Molloy
summary: This two-part documentary re-examines what happened that night, going behind the scenes to show who Fr. Niall, Richard and Teresa were, and uncovers new information that points towards a motive, and possibly the involvement of a third party in his death.

name: Wild Survivors
summary: Every species on Earth faces three great challenges - to find food, to find a home and to reproduce. This series reveals how Zambia's diverse wildlife meets these challenges head on.

name: World's Greatest Islands
summary: A look at the unique beauty and history of the greatest islands in the world, discovering how they were formed and what makes each island so remarkable.

name: World's Greatest Journeys
summary: From France to Antarctica, we reveal the world's greatest journeys and adventures; the most spectacular scenic flights, road trips, river cruises, iconic drives, bike rides, multi-day treks and water-based adventures on the planet.

name: Behind the Wings
summary: Get up-close looks at iconic aircraft, dive into design and development history, and explore the future of aerospace. It's time to go Behind the Wings.

name: Amadeus
summary: Set within the musical hub of bustling Vienna at the end of the 18th century, twenty-five-year-old Amadeus arrives in the city no longer a child and determined to carve his own path. Recently unemployed and without the management of his father, Amadeus finds an unlikely ally in a young singer who will become his wife, fiery Constanze Weber Mozart. Her connections help bring him into the orbit of the court composer Antonio Salieri, setting the three of them on a collision course that will ultimately define their lives and their legacies for years to come.

name: Conan Without Borders
summary: Conan O'Brien decides to explore the world around him.

name: The Disappearance of Gabby Petito
summary: The disappearance of vlogger Gabby Petito gripped America and sparked the internet into a frenzy. For a time, she was the most famous face in the country and the most searched subject on the internet. Everyone wanted to know: Where is Gabby Petito?

name: CNN Newsroom Saturday
summary: View the latest headlines and videos from around the world with CNN's Newsroom.

name: Morning in America
summary: Morning in America is NewsNation's live national morning newscast hosted by Markie Martin.

name: Early Morning
summary: The Latest News and Updates in Morning News.

name: World Sport
summary: Up-to-the minute sports news, highlights and analysis.

name: Postcards
summary: When a Nigerian single mother travels to India for a medical checkup, her journey will end up touching the lives of everyone she meets.

previousepisode.name: A Tree does not make a Forest

name: Century of Love
summary: San accepts pain and suffering in exchange for eternal life, all for the sake of reuniting with his reincarnated former girlfriend. Just as the mysterious power is about to disappear, San meets Vee, a cheerful young man who seems connected to him.

name: Behind the Music
summary: The groundbreaking and prolific music documentary series Behind the Music returns with several new episodes and the best of the vault remastered and updated for today's audiences featuring artist interviews, a creative refresh and reimagined visual style.

name: Te land, ter zee en in de lucht
summary: Participants attempt to descend the ramp and ring the bell in cars, boats, and other modes of transport. With the components Tobbedansen, Snel naar de bel, Op naar de top, and Met je as over de plas, they slide, splash, drive, pedal, push, and ring bells galore! The daredevils and thrill seekers descend the ramp with the most beautiful and fastest creations.

name: Bronx Zoo '90: Crime, Chaos and Baseball
summary: Bronx Zoo '90: Crime, Chaos and Baseball details the tumultuous 1990 New York Yankees season through firsthand accounts of those closest to the team. The docuseries offers rare insight into the crossroads moment when the game's most storied franchise began its ascent from despair to dynasty.

name: Anzac Battlefields
summary: In the First World War more than 80% of Australian fatalities occurred on the main battlefield, facing the main force of the enemy. That battlefield was the Western Front. Australians and New Zealanders were continuously engaged in that theatre from early 1916 until the Armistice, late in 1918. Anzac Battlefields tells the story of the ANZACs on the Western Front, from their first engagement in a small trench raid until their final triumph as an integral part of the "100 Day" advance that led to victory. Through graphics, archive, oral history and travels across the scenes of past battles, Neil Pigot and eminent military historian Dr. Peter Pedersen explain where, why and how the ANZACs fought in France and Belgium 100 years ago.

name: Der pünktlichste Zug der Welt - Unterwegs mit dem Shinkansen
summary: Japan's Shinkansen is the world's most punctual long-distance express train. And it takes us to the most beautiful places in Japan. The journey takes us past some of the most beautiful and original places in Japan: We visit a wasabi farmer, who initiates us into the secrets of the most demanding cultivated plant in the world. In a 400-year-old drum factory, we are there when one of the last giant taiko drums in the world is built. We also take a look behind the scenes of the record-breaking train: We sit in the cockpit with one of the youngest Shinkansen pilots in the country who lets us take a test drive with an almost perfect Shinkansen of the future. A voyage of discovery with the high-tech super train into the soul of Japanese craftsmanship.

previousepisode.name: Von Osaka in den Süden Japans

name: The Style Counsellors
summary: Suzanne Jackson presents with the makeover show that helps people regain their confidence with a new wardrobe.

name: Ashley Madison: Sex, Lies & Scandal
summary: Ashley Madison's members just wanted casual flings. But when the site got hacked, people lost their reputations, marriages — and even their lives.

name: CNN Newsroom Sunday
summary: Updates of the latest news from around the world.

name: Dance Deewane Juniors
summary: For the very first time, Dance Deewane Juniors provides a platform for not just solo kid dancers but also a pool of duos, trios, and kids crews who have not been featured before. The most promising and talented dancers/acts, consisting of solos, duos, trios, and crews will be divided into different teams.

name: Dance+
summary: Contestants from different parts of India showcase their dancing skills and compete against each other to win the prestigious title.

name: Dance+ Pro
summary: The hunt for India's new dancing superstar is on! With high-end tech and innovative dance acts, emerging talents bring their A-game to bag the coveted title.

name: Banlang Luk Thung
summary: When their famous father dies, two ambitious sisters vie for glory in the family folk band as they plot their way to solo stardom - one song at a time.

name: Marbella
summary: César is a successful lawyer based in Marbella, the mafia capital of the world. Handsome, rich, hedonistic, selfish, ambitious, obsessed with social networks... He knows that to maintain his status he has to be the best in court and the man that everyone knows at the wild Marbella parties, where the numerous criminal groups that do business do business. They operate on the Costa del Sol. César is very clear that, in order not to have problems in life, you have to be friends with everyone and never cross certain lines. But when he least expects it, he discovers that he is in the eye of the hurricane and who needs a lawyer to save him is precisely him.

name: Fantasmas
summary: In Fantasmas, Julio Torres tells the tale of when he lost a golden oyster. The people he encounters as he searches for it and the musings he has become points of departure for little films along the way, as Torres navigates weaving in and out of these introspective, often eerie comedic stories.

name: The Green Veil
summary: Gordon Rogers attempts to save an unraveling secret mission that threatens to reveal an unthinkable conspiracy.

name: The Better Sister
summary: Chloe moves through the world with her handsome lawyer husband Adam and teenage son Ethan by her side, while her estranged sister Nicky struggles to stay clean and hustles to make ends meet. When Adam is brutally murdered, the prime suspect sends shockwaves through the family, laying bare long-buried secrets.

name: Je suis chef
summary: Isabelle Racicot animates this sympathetic culinary competition in which three real chefs and three impostors compete in a series of events in order to win $ 3,000 and say I am a chef!

name: Player of Ibiza
summary: In the reality TV show Player of Ibiza, five young testosterone-charged alpha men usually fight for a date with the "Queen" on the Spanish party island. There this time: Rich-Kid Anthony, rapper Marvin, pumper Tim, incel Jeppe and self-made men Abdel. What they don't know is that everything will be different in the show's anniversary season...

name: Sheena: Queen of the Jungle
summary: An orphan raised by wild animals like Tarzan, Sheena commands them and is respected by the local tribes as she fights evil in the savage continent of Africa with help from a trader named Bob and a chimpanzee named Chim.

name: Sorcières mais pas trop !
summary: Witches but not too much is a series centered on the life of Jack Hooper - who describes himself as a musical genius - and on that of his manager and best and loyal friend Gilbert, in Riverdale High School. The series begins when Jack gets fired

name: CNN 10
summary: CNN 10 is a daily news show for students over 13 and other viewers who want to learn about current events and global issues in 10 minutes or less. We represent all sides of a story equally: no opinion; no slant; just the facts. And we have a little fun while doing it!

name: Kameleon
summary: Four childhood friends try to escape from the Antwerp neighborhood where they grew up. A neighborhood where opportunities are few and where many young people are tempted by the 'get rich fast' option of drug crime.

name: Chelworth
summary: Michael Anstey, a wealthy businessman, inherits a title and a stately home.

name: Felices Los 6
summary: Carolina and Damián were made for each other, but they have different ideas about sex and love. If they want to be together, they will have to learn more than one thing about jealousy, prejudice and monogamy.

previousepisode.name: Y Comieron Almejas, Morrones y Chorizos

name: NogiEigo
summary: Nogizaka46 Eigo (乃木坂46えいご) is a Nogizaka46 variety show. Its theme is learning English with Nogizaka46.

name: The Girlfriend
summary: Laura wants for nothing. She has a glittering career, a loving husband, Howard, and, above all, she has Daniel, her precious only son. But Laura's seemingly perfect life is blown apart when Daniel brings home Cherry, the girlfriend who changes everything. After an uncomfortable first meeting, Laura grows convinced that Cherry isn't who she says she is. While no one else can see what she sees, Laura refuses to stand by and watch Daniel be deceived. She'll do anything to protect him. As things go from bad to deadly, the question is, is Cherry a manipulative social climber? Or is Laura paranoid and possessive? The truth is a matter of perspective.

name: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
summary: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage follows Georgie and Mandy as they raise their young family in Texas while navigating the challenges of adulthood, parenting and marriage.

previousepisode.name: A New Beau and Someone Else's Mom's House

nextepisode.name: Feminine Wiles and Some Tire Thing in Lubbock

name: Sheriff Country
summary: Sheriff Country focuses on straight-shooting sheriff Mickey Fox, the stepsister of Cal Fire's division chief Sharon Leone, who investigates criminal activity as she patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father, Wes, who is an off-the-grid marijuana grower, and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

name: Hollywood Squares
summary: Hollywood Squares involves two contestants who play tic-tac-toe to win money and prizes. The "board" for the game is a vertical stack of open-faced cubes, each occupied by a celebrity seated at a desk and facing the contestants. The celebrities are asked questions and the contestants judge the legitimacy of their answers to win the game.

name: Joe Lycett's United States of Birmingham
summary:
It's no secret that Joe Lycett adores Brum, but his hometown is having a tough time of it. In his self-appointed role as the second city's ambassador and with the blessing of the actual Lord Mayor of Birmingham, everyone's favourite comedy activist is on a mission to put Birmingham firmly back on the map – in fact, all over the map.

To do that, Joe is heading to North America, the global destination for multiple Brums, home to no fewer than eighteen Birminghams, stretching from Canada's Saskatchewan province, down the East Coast, through the Midwest and into the Deep South. Joe will explore their history, their collective Brummie cultural commonalities and form official 'Friendship Agreements' with as many US Birminghams as he can. As the climax of the series, Joe will invite some of his new Brummie chums back to his own Birmingham for what will doubtless become an annually bostin global event – the International Day of Birmingham.

name: A League of Their Own: The Rally
summary:
The gang are back for a brand-new adventure show, competing in an epic rally from London to Turin.

Jill Scott, Maisie Adam, Micah Richards and Jamie Redknapp will be paired off into teams and pitted against one another for the ultimate prize - the ALOTO Rally Cup. The dash across Europe will be in six rally stages, deploying planes, trains and automobiles, as each team bids to reach their destination with the most points and hoist the all-important ALOTO Rally Cup.

Along the way, the teams must also complete a series of perilous and sometimes ridiculous off-road challenges to earn points as they blaze through Paris, Lake Geneva, the Alps and finally reach Turin, home of The Italian Job, for their exciting last stretch.

And it wouldn't be A League of Their Own without a few forfeits for the losers – there are no prizes for second place here…

name: The Iris Affair
summary: The Iris Affair is a sun-drenched chase thriller about a rootless and enigmatic genius, Iris Nixon who steals a code from charming philanthropist Cameron McIntyre and goes on the run. Armed only with her lethal intelligence and chameleonic charm, the clock is ticking for her to work out what the code could unleash before she is found.

name: Przesmyk
summary: After losing her pregnancy while in action, Ewa, a Polish spy, wants to withdraw from the secret service to start a normal life. But when her lover is exposed by Russian intelligence and disappears without a trace, she goes on a rescue mission. The suspense thriller series explores the high stakes battle between intelligence agencies on the global stage during an emerging conflict and international unrest.

previousepisode.name: Van homo sapiens naar techno sapiens

name: Deadly Waters with Captain Lee
summary: Deadly Waters with Captain Lee exposes the wicked intentions of those who thought committing crimes on the water would shield them from justice.

name: Dinner Budget Showdown
summary: Dinner Budget Showdown challenge three home cooks to create a five-star meal on a two-star budget. Who will make the best, least expensive dish and win free groceries for a year?

name: Hemvändarna
summary: Documentary series about people who return to Tornedalen, where they were born, to create a life for themselves in their homeland. Finally, they get to experience everyday life in the places they dreamed of, but life doesn't always turn out as they imagined.

name: Advokater
summary: We follow the criminal lawyers Carl-Oskar Morgården, Emma Bardosson and Kristofer Stahre in their work and everyday life. The series tells about the legal challenges, the clients' journey towards their verdicts and everyday life in courtrooms and prisons. We get an exclusive insight into the inner machinery of the rule of law.

name: Fox News @ Night
summary: Fox News @ Night is a live hour of hard news and analysis of the most compelling stories from Washington and across the country.

name: Lovesickness
summary: An ordinary girl, Mo An'an, accidentally travels back a thousand years and meets Xiao Chu, a powerful duke of the Chu state whose influence spans the entire court. To change Xiao Chu's fate of being harmed by treacherous individuals, Mo An'an travels through time three times, experiencing a thousand years of angsty romance with Xiao Chu.

name: Lucky 13
summary: Lucky 13 poses 13 true-or-false questions to its contestants, but there's a twist: Just how well do they know what they know … and, just as importantly, how well do they know what they don't know? If they can accurately predict how successfully they've answered 13 questions, they could take home a $1 million cash jackpot.

name: Orange Soda
summary: Zhou Yu, a girl next door living in a small town, and Cheng Yuzhou, a rich young master who came back from a big city to prepare for the exam, met unexpectedly in the town, and the two fell in love with each other in getting along, and were forced to separate because of the families of the two sides... The love is separated by mountains and seas, can also be peaceful, and the two met again many years later, and all the love in their hearts gushed out and rushed bravely.

name: The Journey of Legend
summary: Xiao Mingming, a man who once loved martial arts novels but had his passion dulled by the realities of life. He experiences the world of martial arts through the perspective of the novel's protagonist, Xiao Qiushui. Starting as a young, impulsive swordsman with little skill, he eventually matures into a heroic figure who values loyalty and defends his family and country. After this journey, Xiao Mingming continues to write in his spare time, using his novels to convey the belief that righteousness brings people together.

name: Sugar Master
summary: Ji Mingtang, CEO of a successful enterprise, came to the "whole sugar northwest" for love because of online dating. He didn't expect to stage a "desert prince" adventure. Here he met a sweet girl who deserved to be protected, Xiang Muyang, and led the local college students to start entrepreneurship and wealth, and harvested a new direction to embark on again!

name: Extraordinary Life in 1993
summary: Song Xiaofeng accidentally time-travels to 1993 and starts a business together with his father Song Jian as a friend, and under the influence of Song Jian and Hu Ruoxi, grows up to go from a depressed man to become a great commercial strategist.

name: An Actor's Rhapsody
summary: This is a story about a wildly imaginative capitalist who fully finances a production team to fulfill his various dreams of being the male lead in historical dramas. His crazed rewriting of the script results in a disjointed storylines. The lowly and poor screenwriter is powerless to resist, desperately trying to fill in the gaps and inconsistencies despite their impending hair loss. The result is a complete departure from the original style, with character development constantly not working out. From palace harem to suspense, from suspense to fantasy, from fantasy to martial arts, from martial arts to palace life, and from palace life to time travel... breaking through the dimensional wall. All types of historical dramas gather together, diverging into a melting pot of themes. With their efforts, the fantasy genre will be introduced to geographical continental plates for the first time; the cold-faced male lead's soul is actually a piece of ancient ice that has existed for thousands of years; the palace harem is unusually harmonious, with deep sisterly bonds; the case-solving suspense of the imperial guards is full of suspense but the murderer is never found throughout the show; a scholar on the road to the imperial exam is unexpectedly crowned the champion of the martial world through a rich girl's investment; the male fox, who is both good and evil, and the female demon-hunter, who switches personalities frequently, are unable to resist temptation and become enemies due to love. Even the protagonist's friend's dog, brought on set during a visit, is turned into a spirit to add to the story, with a romantic subplot added... However, behind all the absurdity, you will discover that he is an actor pursuing his dreams and redemption with unbridled passion.

name: Aktiv på dagtid
summary: - In all the jobs I've had, I've had time off during the day. I think the offer for us day drivers is too bad, so I decided to open my apartment every week for visitors. "Active during the day" is a low-threshold offer for other people who also have nothing to do during the day, says Lars Berrum.

name: Alarm 113
summary: Norwegian documentary series where you get an insight into the everyday life of those who work at the AMK central, meet victims who have been exposed to dramatic events and see them meet their rescuers again.

name: Alt for Årdal
summary: The industrial village of Årdal is fighting against eviction at the same time that the villagers rise up and zealots, little kings, mothers and players dream of promotion to 3 div in football.

previousepisode.name: Småstein mot bulldosar – men det skal klirra!

name: Amerikanske tilstander
summary: TV 2 Nyheter follows the mid-term elections in the USA. The election will determine who gets a majority in Congress and the Senate.

name: Aslak og Aleks tar valget
summary: Aslak Maurstad and Aleksander Sæterstøl are doing something they have never done before - they are going to learn about politics. Because what exactly is a municipal election? The goal is to become as wise as possible, in the shortest possible time.

name: Baneheia: Rettssaken
summary: TV 2's crime reporters summarize, explain and analyze the new Baneheia trial against Jan Helge Andersen.

previousepisode.name: Baneheia: Rettssaken – Det unike møtet i retten

name: Bra godt
summary: Klaus Sonstad loves good food, but is unsure whether good food can also be healthy. Nutritionist and doctor Berit Nordstrand invites him home to her kitchen where they cook delicious and healthy Norwegian everyday food. Together with the viewers, Klaus learns new twists on well-known food, and has a number of "aha" experiences along the way.

name: Bra nytt
summary: In Bra nytt, we take the pulse of what is happening around the country. In the broadcasts, we have issues about news, sport and culture - and are happy to put politicians on the wall when needed. TV BRA takes up the issues that developmentally disabled people in Norway are concerned with.

name: Broompraten
summary: In Broompraten, Mats Brustad meets a bunch of well-known profiles to talk about cars and the passion around them. In the series, we get to know everything from Petter Solberg and Eyvind Hellstrøm to former prime minister Erna Solberg.

previousepisode.name: Dennis Hauger kan bli Norges første Formel 1-fører

name: Budkrigen
summary: Gunhild Dahlberg and Sturla Berg-Johansen are back with a brand new program series; Budkrigen. They follow buyers, brokers and sellers closely during the bidding rounds. Which tactics are smart to choose? What should you know before jumping into a bidding round?

name: Bygd reis deg
summary: The fire in Lærdal is one of the biggest fire disasters since the war. How did it actually go with the people in Lærdal in the months that followed and until today?

name: Camilla anbefaler film og serier
summary: Film reviewer Camilla Laache reviews films for "Good morning Norway". Now she gives you tips on what you can watch on TV 2 Sumo!

name: Bønder i by'n
summary: Anders Østensen and his two good helpers, farmers Inga Berit Lein and Ingvald Erga, come to town on a tractor to give good advice and common sense to the townspeople.

name: Camp Kjær
summary: Jan Tore Kjær gathers six young people to find Furuset's next ice hockey star.

name: De bortførte barna
summary: Every year several children are abducted from their mother or father. Left behind are desperate parents who are willing to do everything they can to get their children back. Marco Elsafadi meets both parties and tries to get dialogue and help from the authorities. His goal is for the children to have as good a time as possible.

name: Wild Mediterranean
summary: As predator and prey fight to survive in the varied lands and waters of the Mediterranean, the fate of the next generation is decided.

name: Angelina Ballerina: The Next Steps
summary: Join Angelina Ballerina as she finds her way in her new school, puts together her own show and tries to land a leading role in the Mouskinov Ballet. Prepare to pirouette along with everyone's favorite ballerina in these sparkling stories!

name: Титаны
summary: Artificial intelligence challenges the strongest people in Russia. TNT TV channel is conducting an incredible sports experiment using the latest technologies. After analyzing a huge amount of data, the neural network has created a series of complex tests to test what the human body is capable of. In the special space of our experiment, the strongest people in Russia, real Titans, will compete for the title of the strongest winner of the show and a prize of 10 million rubles. Will people be able to withstand the power of artificial intelligence?

name: Clash of the Titans
summary: The battle between righteousness and demons has lasted for a thousand years. The leader of the righteous sect, Sword Sovereign Feng Yue, and the demonic cult's Star Lord, Feng Xingtian, engage in a life-and-death duel. Meanwhile, their successors, Shen Shaoyou and Feng Lixue, form an unexpected friendship by chance. To protect his master, Shen Shaoyou accidentally pushes Lixue off a cliff. Lixue is rescued and taken away by Chong Hua, the strongest expert of the demonic cult. From that moment, their fates are rewritten—Lixue is destined to become the leader of the demonic cult, while Shen Shaoyou will rise as the righteous alliance's leader, setting them on an inevitable path to confrontation. Through countless trials and tribulations, they come to recognize each other's true hearts and ultimately stand together once more. Regardless of whether they hail from righteousness or evil, whether they grow up in celestial realms or demonic domains, one thing remains unchanged—their unwavering sense of justice and love.

name: Fall in Love with a Fox
summary: Story of a cook who lost her memory, and an elegant qin player; who set out to establish a new order of Jianghu.

name: Ich bin Dagobert
summary: The six-part miniseries retells the largest blackmail case in Germany from different perspectives. In 1988 and from 1992 to 1994, Arno Funke committed bomb and arson attacks to extort department stores. In the latter case, a previously unknown media hype broke out around the hunt for the man behind the duck mask, who made history under the pseudonym "Dagobert". Arno Funke alias "Dagobert" is available as a consultant for the project.

name: Massive Engineering Mistakes
summary: Massive Engineering Mistakes some of which have devastating outcomes occur across the globe, and are assessed by design teams, eyewitnesses and experts who analyze what went wrong and how engineers are fixing them.

name: Infamy: When Fame Turns Deadly
summary: A true crime series hosted by singer-songwriter and actress Monica exploring celebrity cases where notoriety and fame turn fatal. Each episode unravels the mystery and the motives behind the crimes; revealing a dark side to being in the public eye when betrayal, jealousy, and greed lead to tragedy.

previousepisode.name: Let's finish what Maya Wada left unfinished

name: Dear Mr. Right
summary: The valiant overlord who can down a thousand cups without getting drunk meets the seemingly gentle husband who cannot even take one drop of alcohol. Did she catch herself a koi husband or is she facing a shroud of mystery?

name: A Ming Dynasty Adventure
summary: Wei Cai Wei transforms into a wandering doctor and comes to the capital alone, vowing to find out the truth about her father's desperate efforts to rescue refugees during the "Gengxu Rebellion" but was framed instead. Wei Cai Wei is walking on thin ice, avoiding the pursuit of those behind the scenes while digging into the past. In the process, Wei Cai Wei meets Lu Ying, a hot-blooded and upright Jin Yi Wei, Wang Da Xia, who appears to be a playboy but is actually wise and brave, and they become close friends who depend on each other in life and death situations.

name: Raw & Real: The Truth Be Told
summary: Exploring the minds of queer icons, legends, and trailblazers, Raw & Real: The Truth Be Told sits down with everyone from international drag star Katya Zamolodchikova to cult director Darren Stein with exclusive interviews on their lives and careers. Get to know the ins-and-outs of their lives, including never before seen footage of photoshoots and music videos.

name: Cash Cab Music
summary: Riders test their music knowledge for cash in this fun trivia show!

name: Connecting Africa
summary: For Connecting Africa, CNN profiles the people, projects and companies revolutionizing African business and bringing the continent together.

name: Uninterrupted: The Real Stories of Basketball
summary: Discover the legendary players, iconic teams, and epic moments in hoops history that changed the culture forever. Untold stories from both on and off the court, following those with relentless drive, who will stop at nothing to achieve their dreams.

name: Shi Bing Tu Ji Tan Ke
Punt and Dennis
summary: Steve Punt and Hugh Dennis, who contributed sketches to "Canned Carrott" before finding fame with David Baddiel and Rob Newman in "The Mary Whitehouse Experience", bring their double act to television.

name: Yi Hao Jian Cha Jian Yi
Once Upon a Time in Longfan
summary: A 20-year-old photo foretells gruesome deaths. Qin Ming must uncover the truth: fate, curse, or calculated murder?

name: Veil of Shadows
summary: Lu Wuyi, the youngest nine-tailed fox of the mysterious Formless Moon Sect, sets out on a mission with her friend Wu Wangyan to track down a fox demon on the run, Xiaowei. She infiltrates the Wei Mansion in Luo'an City, where she later crosses paths with Wu Shiguang, who holds a deep grudge, as well as Ji Ling and Li Jie, demon hunters from the Shilin Sect. In the process of uncovering the truth, they navigate between suspicion and cooperation, each driven by their own agendas. In their repeated struggles over the Dragon Deity's Power, their fates are changed time and again. To preserve peace in the world, they make painful sacrifices and ultimately subdue Jiu Ying, the lord of all demons, thus fulfilling an enduring quest of love and redemption.

name: The Let's Go Show
summary: Airing every Saturday and Sunday, this hosted programming block encourages preschoolers to ask questions, be curious about the world around them and participate in a daily musical adventure. Host Miles and his puppy friend Banjo, an adorable and spirited puppet who loves to play her homemade banjo, embark each afternoon on a musical journey. Miles loves to sing, discover new things and connect with viewers to help them learn through humor, music and interactive play. Always ready for adventure, Banjo represents the wonder, energy and curiosity of a preschooler. The show also weaves in episodes of kids' favorite shows, including Bob The Builder,™ and Angelina Ballerina™.

name: Det Nye-jenta
summary: Norway's most read blogger Caroline Berg Eriksen, last year's "New Girl" Karn Kjerstad and lifestyle blogger Espen Hilton are looking for "The New Girl 2014".

name: Doktor Per
summary: Per Aarhaug was born in Cameroon in Africa and has lived there most of his life. His parents were Norwegian missionaries. Per grew up close to nature and early on became fond of everything that lives - animals, plants and people. As a young man, Per traveled to Norway to study medicine. When he returned to Cameroon, he was shocked by what met him. Poaching, overgrazing, deforestation and predatory exploitation of natural resources were on the way to destroying the country.

name: Drømmen om Birken
summary: "Birken" is the name of the new folk disease - over sixty thousand Norwegians are affected. Who are they? What do they want? What drives them?

name: Marcus Wareing Simply Provence
summary: A feast for the senses. The Michelin-starred chef celebrates the south of France, unlocking the secrets of simple, seasonal cuisine - and adding a British twist to the classics.

name: Ekstremsportveko
summary: We bring you the most spectacular moments from Ekstremsportveko on Voss - with parachute, river kayaking, dead-singing, longboarding and much more.

name: En varslet skandale
summary: In 2018, the former biathlete president Anders Besseberg is charged with corruption and for having hidden Russian doping. The documentary series shows a hitherto unknown side of Europe's biggest winter sport.

name: Exit Trump
summary: What now, America? Exit Trump follows the aftermath of a very special presidency. While Donald Trump is being impeached for the second time, President Joe Biden will lead a United States where the challenges are lined up. "Exit Trump" is an informal current affairs program with exciting guests and a good mood, which makes you a little wiser.

name: Fisken som bygde landet
summary: In two programmes, you can join Arne Hjeltnes on a journey from the dangerous and colorful Lofoten fishing, to a food festival in Italy and culinary food experiences in the dried fish nation of Nigeria.

name: Follestad gjør ting han kunne før
summary: Three years ago, Erik Follestad Johansen put his skates on the shelf. In these years he has been an expert, but now he will lace up his skates again to show Norway that he is still good enough. Follestad takes us inside the clubs in the top division, tells unknown stories and will try to fit into the team. Whether he gets a contract or not is up to the coaches. Will he be successful, or have three years of celebrity life and minimal training turned "Folle" into an amateur?

name: Glow Up
summary: Make-up is no longer just foundation and mascara, and never before has interest in advanced make-up been greater. Join the hunt for Norway's next makeup star!

name: Grenseløse Telemark
summary: Simon Nitsche and Magnus Midtbø meet for a boundless duel in Telemark. Can the sports anchor beat the athlete and be left with the trophy at Gaustatoppen?

name: Hagetid
summary: Illustrator Gunvor Rasmussen, carpenter Julian Simon and landscape gardener Steven Stiberg Long are the three-leaf clover who, together with various designers, will fix the gardens of different families. They are given free rein to spruce up people's gardens - and they have to do it in four days.

name: Heder og Hammer
summary: Katarina Flatland occupies celebrities' houses with a team of designers and workers to refurbish a room. Parallel to the renovation, we get to know the celebrity's life and career through conversations and activities together with Katarina.

name: Helsesista
summary: Tale Maria Krohn Engvik is the public health nurse who decided to reach out more widely to young people by communicating with them in their own arena. With a mix of serious knowledge, humor and personality, she reaches up to 150,000 viewers on Snapchat daily. Now she has created a TV series for and with young people where difficult and taboo topics such as sex, the body, nude images, suicidal thoughts and heartbreak are addressed in a simple and harmless way.

name: Helt ny på 100 minutter
summary: We have gathered a professional styling team with experts in clothes, make-up and hair whose goal is simple: They will prove that it is possible to transform a lucky woman and give her a new and cooler style. And they only need 100 minutes!

name: Hjertebarna
summary: In this Norwegian documentary series, we follow children with heart disease in their everyday lives. We get to see how they are with their families at home and how they prepare for vital operations at Oslo University Hospital Rikshospitalet.

name: Hop Stars
summary: Hop Stars is a basketball team from Bergen for players with special needs - and who need tailored training. In autumn 2022, the team got to represent Norway in a major Special Olympics tournament in Italy. We follow the players in their everyday lives, both at home and at work, on the way to the games in Tuscany.

name: Hvem bryr seg
summary: In this show, a hidden camera is used to test people's helpfulness, and the question is quite simple - who cares?

name: Hvordan overleve
summary: Based on her own life, presenter Marthe Sveberg seeks answers to questions she is not alone in asking: How can I make my marriage last? When will I stop hating my own appearance? Do I have a normal relationship with my family? Why does the job make me so vulnerable? In the search for answers, Marthe meets people with quite different answers and experiences.

name: Jenter på hjul
summary: Charlotte Mohn and Hedda Kise are on a cycle tour - in known and unknown places, meet known and unknown people and take part in exciting activities.

name: Kampen for livet
summary: We follow nine people of different ages who have been diagnosed with cancer. The series gives a close and personal picture of the course of their illness and how cancer affects their lives and those close to them.

name: Eyewitness WWII: Invasion Italy
summary: From the shores of Sicily to the heights of the Apennine Mountains, Eyewitness WWII: Invasion Italy captures the stories of those who experienced the harrowing two-year campaign first-hand and highlights the importance that hard-fought battles in Italy and the Mediterranean played in the ultimate outcome of the war.

name: Kjendisrestauranten
summary: Four famous people will run a restaurant for four days. The celebrities will take turns in the roles of cook, waiter, cleaning help and restaurant manager. Who makes the funnest concept? And who serves the best food?

name: The Killer Interview with Piers Morgan
summary: Piers Morgan interviews some of the most infamous murderers in the U.S. Featuring some of the nation's most fiercely contested cases, exclusive interviews, and sensational revelations, these convicted killers all have one thing in common; they insist they are innocent. In a close-quarters, one hour interview, this is the murderer's chance to give their side of the story.

name: The Perfect Suspect
summary: Adapted from Chen Yanyi's new social school suspense novel "The Perfect Suspect", the story begins with a seemingly flawless crime that unravels the 'pathology' of human nature beneath the surface. Intertwined with a case involving children, it serves as a mirror reflecting the many faces of society.

name: Holidaying in the 70s: Wish You Were Here
summary:
The 1970s ushered in a travel revolution – suddenly Britain was saying ‘adios' to wet weekends by the sea, and jetting off to package destinations on the Costas that weren't even built yet! This two-part series takes a step back in time to when all of this was thrillingly new – when sangria, pesetas and siestas became part of our vocab; when holiday brochures dominated our doormats; and holiday programmes took over the airways.

We take modern holiday makers on a trip down memory lane, in a recreated high street travel agency, and aboard an authentic 1970s plane. We uncover a secret history of backrooms deals with dictatorships that helped finance our favourite resorts, as well as holiday deals and food options that you wouldn't get nowadays. From mass travel to hippy trail wanderlust, this show takes us back to the decade that started it all.

name: Fox News Live
summary: The latest political and socio-economic news and updates from around the world, live.

previousepisode.name: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter: The Training Journey

name: RU
summary: A story that begins when you think it's over... An extraordinary love affair despite all odds in a coastal town in the Aegean... A 38-year-old woman and an 18-year-old man: Reyan and Uzer

name: Thousandaires
summary: Comedians are given a thousand dollars to spend on their friends and their wildest dreams.

name: James MacDonald - Walk in the Word
summary: The Bible-teaching ministry of Pastor James MacDonald, emphasizing the precise exposition of God's Word and its practical life application. James MacDonald is the Senior Pastor of Harvest Bible Chapel in Chicago, Ill.

name: The Crow Girl
summary:
The Crow Girl begins with the gruesome discovery of a teenage boy's body discarded in plain sight. Determined to find who is responsible, DCI Jeanette Kilburn joins forces with psychotherapist Dr Sophia Craven to hunt the killer despite opposition from her superiors including confidant DI Lou Stanley.

The investigation takes them into a dangerous world of historic abuse and murder. Together they uncover a chain of shocking events involving the disappearance of children that have gone overlooked for decades, as well as evidence of police corruption. As the body count rises and the two women are dragged into the depths of the murders, an intimacy starts to form between them, and so begins a complex, twisted love story. All the while, the killer is inching ever closer to home.

name: Traitor/Patriot
summary: Traitor/Patriot gives you an insider's look at the motivation behind the people who committed espionage.

name: Mr. Garlund
summary: An apparently orphaned boy is taken in and raised by a Chinese gentleman named Po Chang. The boy, named Frank Garlund, and whose ancestry remains a mystery, becomes, by age thirty, a financial wizard, a youthful tycoon, who is also a key figure in worldwide business affairs In flashback sequences, events in the lives of the people who had come into contact with Garlund in his struggle to reach the top are dramatized.

name: Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister
summary: Uryu Kamihate is a high school student hoping to enroll in Kyoto University's medical school. After being taken in by the chief priest at Amagami Shrine, he is told he must marry one of three maiden sisters—Yae, Yuna, or Asahi—to live at, and one day inherit, the Amagami Shrine. Kamihate will need to sweep one of the maidens off her feet in this story of romance, friendship, and fun.

previousepisode.name: Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister

name: Kjære mamma
summary: We follow mums of different ages and get to take part in their small and big challenges in everyday life. A steady stream of other mothers comment and share experiences. "Kjære mamma" is an expert-free, feel-good series about what it really means to be a mother today.

name: Kjærlighet til alle
summary: Three former "Jakten på kjærligheten" profiles move into a beautiful farm. Here they will meet 15 suitors with whom they will blind date, and live with for a period of time. There will be dating, barn dancing and fun - and maybe some surprises. Everyone wants to find that great love, will it be a match or will they end up single?

name: Kokkenes kamp
summary: Cooking competition where ten of the country's best chefs settle in a manor house to compete in classic cooking skills!

name: Komikameratene
summary: Four of Norway's best comedians are going on tour throughout Norway, and on the road they will develop the show together. But can the four strong individualists work so closely together? And are they still mates at the end of the road?

name: Kommentatorskolen
summary: Impersonator king Kasper Foss's big dream is to become a real football commentator. In this series, we follow Kasper's journey towards the big baptism of fire: his very own match in the Obosligaen. On the way, Kasper seeks out several of his own idols in the field. What is in the DNA of a solid sports commentator? And what must Kasper take with him if he is to live his dream?

name: Kort og lovende
summary: A series about short people in Norway, outsiders, prejudices and how you can find your own way even if you feel different.

name: Kronprinsparet – vårt Norge
summary: Join the crown prince couple as they show us their Norway, in the year they both turn 50. On the way, we get to know the Crown Prince couple better, who they are, and what engages them. On the journey, they meet people where they are, often on home visits.

previousepisode.name: – Dette har vi aldri gjort før

name: Kroppen din
summary: Our body is absolutely amazing, but how does it really work? The half hour of information has arrived. We clear up myths, test limits and show you how the body actually works.

name: Kystmat
summary: Trond and Rune were born and raised by the coast, and love everything it offers in terms of exciting experiences and wonderful ingredients. The mountain goat Margit, on the other hand, gets seasick just at the thought, and with the boys as teachers, she gets to try everything that a land crab can't really do anything about. Together they will seek out culinary experiences along the southern coast. "Kystmat" with Rune & Margit & Moi offers spontaneous comedy, magnificent nature, exciting experiences and master cooking in a delightful mix.

name: Made in Norway
summary: All over Norway there are entrepreneurs who are working hard to make their dreams come true. Who has what it takes? And how much are they willing to sacrifice?

name: Nattarbeiderne
summary: Nattarbeiderne is a series with a high pace and a lot of drama. During the series, we get to know security guards, crime photographers, the military police, the emergency room in Drammen, the MMA fighter, the loggers, the VG editors, the Burlesque school and many more.

name: Per og Baharehs Grand Hotel
summary: How does it go when ex-minister Per Sandberg and former Miss Iran, Bahareh Letnes, take over the Grand Bar and Hotel in the border town of Halden?

name: Påskereisen
summary: Påskereisen is a meeting between two people with very different life situations. A journey from city to mountain brings them together. Easter is the setting for the journey. There will be touching moments and good conversations. Charlotte Mohn Gaustad dishes up delicious Easter food. The series ends in Tøyenkirken with an Easter dinner accompanied by Jonas Fjeld.

name: Redesign
summary: Two design teams will compete to decorate a room. With zero kroner in the budget, they will create a concept each, then they find used things at recycling centers and finn.no, among others, which they use to create beautiful designer furniture.

name: Reisen til Love Island
summary: In Reisen til Love Island, we follow presenter Morten Hegseth in his preparations for the job that awaits him when he will lead this winter's big venture Love Island.

name: rom123
summary: Norwegian interior program which aims to help all viewers interested in interior design to create a living and personal home - without costing the shirt!

name: Secrets & Spies: A Nuclear Game
summary: Betray your country, save the world. Spies and traitors play a dangerous game in the 1980s as the Cold War brings two superpowers to the brink of nuclear war.

name: Science of Thrills
summary: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell climbs aboard some of the world's fastest theme park rides and discovers how these rides affect the human body.

name: Jukkakukan no Satsujin
summary: In 1986, Tsunojima Island was home to the Decagonal House, a strange mansion with a decagonal appearance. The genius architect who built the mansion, Nakamura Seiji, died mysteriously in the burnt-down main building, Aoyashiki. Six months later, seven members of the University Mystery Research Club visit Tsunojima, which has become a deserted island, for a training camp. Meanwhile, on the mainland across the sea, Kawaminami Takaaki, a former member of the Mystery Research Club, receives a letter from Nakamura Seiji, who was supposed to be dead. As he continues his investigation, Konan meets a man named Shimada Kiyoshi, and they start working together. Meanwhile, in the Decagonal House, one of the members of the Mystery Research Club is murdered by someone. "Who on earth is the culprit?" The members become suspicious and start to suspect each other... It will be a week before they can leave the isolated island of Tsunoshima. What is the shocking conclusion beyond imagination that arises from these two stories?

name: Богиня сыска
summary: Goddess of Detection is a romantic experiment about searching and dating. Will the bachelor be able to choose a girl by the appearance of her apartment? He will study everything - clothes, books, the contents of closets and shelves. But will the girl agree to a date after a return search at the guy's home? Bloggers Ilya Kuruch, Vika Chuma, and fashion expert Daniil Grachev will comment on what is happening.

name: Погружение
summary: How could an innocent and slightly illegal trip to a classified career end up? Igor, a black digger, diver and just an adventure lover, comes here with his brother and a group of friends in search of an ancient settlement. Diving into a quarry turns into a surprise... Divers find themselves prisoners of the anomalous zone. The zone was classified due to secret experiments, and... people were left to live in their cocoons. Will they be able to get out of a parallel world that exists according to their own laws? ..

name: Broken Trust
summary: Businessman Chin Tai-hoi calls the shots in the office and at home. Tai-hoi is certain his son Chin Kai-loy is incompetent, so he forces him to make progress by continually putting pressure on him. Although Tai-hoi's lover Hung Mui-kwai has been hinting all kinds of ideas to him, but Tai-hoi still has not promised to honor her. Tai-hoi's daughter Chin Yau-fong goes into business while keeping her father in the dark. Tai-hoi slyly undermines her efforts as he feels betrayed. Tai-hoi is kidnapped. And staff member Chiu Yat-ming comes to his rescue. Tai-hoi becomes suspicious of people around him, so he moves into Yat-ming's home. And he wants Yat-ming to covertly investigate. However, Yat-ming's father Chiu Chi-yung is astonishingly Yau-fong's ex-boyfriend, whom Tai-hoi disliked. Tai-hoi always loves money more than anything else. But his way of thinking somehow changes as he gets along with Yat-ming.

name: Arnacœur ou prince charmant
summary: A single woman will meet 14 men who have everything to please her. She is unaware that, as in everyday life, some men she is going to meet are not there for sincere reasons... They are seducers! And if one of them succeeds in being the chosen one of his heart, he will win 20,000 euros. Will our single person succeed in detecting true love and avoiding the trap of seducers?

name: Yakuzas : Les mafieux légendaires au Japon
summary: Based on the exclusive testimonies of several of them, as well as insights and archive footage, this is a fascinating immersion into the ritualized world of the yakuza, legendary mobsters now in decline.

name: The Power : Qui a le pouvoir ?
summary: Each week, chance will designate a participant as the Power Player, who will have all the powers in the house and will decide who sleeps where, who eats what, who has this privilege or that handicap. But he will have to keep his identity secret at all costs. At the end of the week, the Power Player will designate the player who will be eliminated. Unless he unmasks the Power Player, in which case it is the latter who will be eliminated! Between strategies, alliances and low blows, who will be able to tame power?

name: Un chef au bout du monde avec Philippe Etchebest
summary: After 30 years travelling through the kitchens of France, chef Philippe Etchebest sets out to discover other flavors, other products and other cultures.

name: Terminal
summary: Jack, a captain who manages his personal life as poorly as his plane, and Charlie his co-pilot, relegated from a prestigious company to Flywingz, are forced to collaborate. To do this, they will be supported by an astonishing team of cabin crew: the naive Nelly, Nabil, the most unpredictable steward the sky has ever known, Tristan the arriviste, and Armelle, an activist in all battles. An inspection visit that turns into a fiasco, a child who takes the controls of the plane or a safety training session that goes awry: our (almost) always united team of broken arms will try as best they can to manage these absurd situations. And too bad if the methods adopted do not always respect security procedures. Good flight !

name: GIGN, unité d'élite
summary: The GIGN, an intervention group of the national gendarmerie, is celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2024. Each episode of the series deciphers a daring mission.

name: Les Secrets des fratés
summary: For more than 10 years now, the people of Marseillais have been living their adventures in the four corners of the world! For Paga and Julien, it's time to delve back into memories... The two friends will review the highlights of all the seasons of the show that changed their lives, and comment on them by giving their version of things and revealing to you unpublished anecdotes… Discover the first reaction of the Marseillais… by the Marseillais!

name: Une amitié dangereuse
summary: Two women, young and beautiful, form a strong friendship. Marie de Rohan, Duchess of Chevreuse, lively and cheerful, free in body and mind, who collects adventures, and Anne of Austria, Queen of France, prudish and shy who, married too young and abandoned by her husband the king Louis XIII suffers from neurasthenia.

name: Las Largas Sombras
summary: The lives of a group of women are suddenly turned upside down by the discovery of the human remains of one of their classmates, who disappeared during a school trip to Majorca twenty-five years earlier.

name: Au micro
summary: In 2024/2025, the new UEFA Champions League format, with even more matches, will be broadcast in full on CANAL+ channels. With this in mind, to strengthen its team of commentators, CANAL+ has launched a search for a new voice to commentate on football on its channels. An exceptional recruitment process, in several stages, open for the first time to all football fans. Competitors aged 18 to 64, from all professional and social categories.

name: Sip & Gossip
summary: Welcome to Sip & Gossip, the podcast presented by Maghla where we read all your little unspoken secrets.

name: Au cœur du collège, un an à Jean Vilar
summary: This documentary series aims to reveal and understand education, its challenges, its hopes, its successes, and sometimes its limits. At an age when everything is possible - at this turning point in life - this unique program offers an uncompromising, but empathetic, look at life in a REP (Priority Education Network) middle school. Students and teachers alike will talk about the difficulties as well as the successes encountered throughout this school year.

name: Songs of Ireland
summary: Entertainer and musician Pat Shortt and Stockton's Wing frontman Mike Hanrahan, take a musical road trip around Ireland to discover the history behind some of our greatest songs.

name: Haantjes
summary: Mike, Daan, Ivo and Greg are facing a world that has evolved without them. Some are ready to rethink their ways; others try to reaffirm their manhood.

name: Экстрасенсы против ученых
summary: Two clans take part in the show - a team of psychics and a team of scientists. They have to fight each other. In these tests they must use only their own methods: scientists - the method of scientific analysis, psychics - superpowers and secret forces of nature! Who will win?

name: Исповедь экстрасенса
summary: A true and complete life story of the country's most famous psychics. Never before have they been so candid in front of the camera. What is it like to have the gift of foresight and know everything in advance? Why can't they protect their loved ones from misfortune, and which of these superhumans is capable of ordinary tears?

name: The Village Green
summary: The town of St. Maurice is in an economic crisis until an unlikely cash crop saves the day.

name: My Marvellous Dream Is You
summary: I'm Dawan. Since I can remember, I have always had strange dreams about a quiet girl who often played with me in my dreams. One day, a new neighbor moved in, and that led to my family falling apart. My father ran away with the man next door, who turned out to be the father of Khimhan the quiet and small girl from next door. Initially, we were not close at all, but circumstances brought us closer and made us understand each other. However, Khimhan was unaware that while in the real world we were just friends, in my dreams, she and I did things that went far beyond that. So, I kept my feelings concealed because I couldn't let her know. I never realized that in those dreams, I was not the only one dreaming.

name: Boonie Bears
summary: In a lovely wooded wonderland in rural Northeast China. Though the surroundings might seem idyllic, the peace has been disrupted by the dastardly Logger Vick, who schemes to transform the majestic forest into his own personal lumberyard! Too bad for Vick-two strapping brown-bear brothers are determined to thwart his plans and send him packing.

name: Dariba Diaries
summary: Set in 19th century Delhi, our story takes place at a time when technology and science are still in their infancy and modern tools of investigation haven't yet been invented. While Bahadur Shah Zafar II reigns ostensibly, the British might and influence increase each day, and with it, a spate of crimes. As crime multiplies, the police grapple to keep up with the mounting unsolved cases. Under these circumstances, when the Kotwal finds himself in the midst of a felonious mystery, he seeks the help of the only man who can come to his aid, Mirza Jaan Nawaz. Though eccentric in his methods of investigation, Mirza proves himself time and again, unraveling a new mystery with every case. Without the aid of technology, Mirza relies on the most potent tool of all his brains! With an equal measure of intelligence and looks, Mirza Jaan Nawaz knows how to maneuver every situation. But Mirza only has eyes for his love, Zeenat, from whom he often seeks counsel.

name: Klimawechsel
summary: Four women, all teachers at Munich's Novalis high school, feel the sword of Damocles of the menopause threateningly hover above them - Angelika has hot flashes, Beate uncontrolled emotional outbursts, Cornelia gets panic attacks and Desiree is suffering from nervous exhaustion. However, all four realize that life also continues in this stage of life - albeit on winding paths.

name: LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy
summary: The entire Star Wars Galaxy gets completely mixed up when an ordinary nerf-herder, Sig Greebling, unearths a powerful artifact from a hidden Jedi temple. He finds himself thrust into adventure in a new, wondrously wild and twisted version of the galaxy where good guys are bad, bad guys are good and the fate of all depends on Sig becoming the hero who can put all the pieces back together.

name: Food Rescue Kitchen
summary: Join foodie influencer and home baker Naomi Toilalo as she challenges Top Chefs around Aotearoa to create a three course meal out of food she's rescued.

name: Crutch
summary: Crutch is a Harlem widower whose empty nest plans are put on hold after his millennial son and free-spirited daughter move back home.

name: The Great War
summary:
The Great War is a four-hour cinematic documentary covering U.S. involvement in World War I in the critical year of 1918. After three years of horrific battle in the trenches of France and Belgium, the Allies are on the verge of collapse—and Germany the cusp of victory. The United States is forced to rapidly train, arm, and ship millions of young soldiers overseas to Europe for the first time.

Our story follows General John J. Pershing, leader of the American Expeditionary Force, who is charged with training and deploying an army almost from scratch; Michael B. Ellis, a young man fighting with the Army's soon to be legendary Big Red One; and Horace Pippin and Henry Johnson, brave African American soldiers whose courage in battle helped their regiment be christened the Harlem Hellfighters.

The Great War weaves together the stories of these four men to tell one story: how an isolationist America reluctantly entered World War I and emerged a global power.
